20.1.prompt: The windows are cleaned every Friday. Gapning grammatik egasini aynan yozing.
20.1.explanation: Passive gapda windows ishni bajarmaydi, lekin grammatik ega vazifasida turadi.

20.2.prompt: Present Simple Passive bilan to‘ldiring: Fresh bread ___ (deliver) here every morning.
20.2.explanation: Bread sanalmaydigan birlik ot; is + V3 odatiy passive harakatni bildiradi.

20.2.prompt: Present Simple Passive: These herbs ___ (grow) without chemicals.
20.2.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi herbs bilan are, grow fe’lining V3 shakli grown ishlatiladi.

20.3.prompt: Present Simple Passive inkori: This corridor ___ (not clean) on Saturdays.
20.3.explanation: Birlikdagi corridor bilan is not + V3 keladi.

20.3.prompt: Present Simple Passive inkori: Glass bottles ___ (not accept) in this box.
20.3.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi bottles bilan are not + V3 ishlatiladi.

20.4.prompt: Odatiy jarayon haqida to‘g‘ri passive savolni tanlang: A) Are these uniforms washed here? B) Do these uniforms washed here?
20.4.explanation: Present Simple Passive savolida am/is/are egadan oldinga chiqadi; do ishlatilmaydi.

20.4.prompt: Present Simple Passive savolidagi fe’lni to‘ldiring: Where is this cheese ___ (make)?
20.4.explanation: Is egadan oldin, make fe’lining V3 shakli made egadan keyin keladi.

20.5.prompt: Past Simple Passive: The community garden ___ (open) last April.
20.5.explanation: O‘tgan tugallangan voqea uchun birlikdagi ega bilan was + V3 kerak.

20.5.prompt: Past Simple Passive: These photographs ___ (take) in 1998.
20.5.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi ega bilan were va take ning V3 shakli taken keladi.

20.6.prompt: Past Simple Passive inkori: The invitation ___ (not send) yesterday.
20.6.explanation: Birlikdagi ega uchun was not + V3; send ning uchinchi shakli sent.

20.6.prompt: Past Simple Passive inkori: The old lockers ___ (not remove) last week.
20.6.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi ega bilan were not + V3 ishlatiladi.

20.7.prompt: Past Simple Passive savolini tanlang: A) Did the sign replaced yesterday? B) Was the sign replaced yesterday?
20.7.explanation: Past Simple Passive savolida was/were egadan oldin keladi, did emas.

20.7.prompt: Past Simple Passive savolining birinchi so‘zini yozing: ___ the benches repaired before the festival?
20.7.explanation: Benches ko‘plik; so‘roq tartibi were + ega + V3.

20.8.prompt: Present Continuous Passive: The roof ___ (repair) right now.
20.8.explanation: Hozir davom etayotgan passive harakat is being + V3 bilan tuziladi.

20.8.prompt: Present Continuous Passive: New trees ___ (plant) along our street at the moment.
20.8.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi trees bilan are being + V3 ishlatiladi.

20.9.prompt: Present Continuous Passive inkori: The main hall ___ (not use) this afternoon.
20.9.explanation: Birlikdagi ega bilan is not being + V3 kerak.

20.9.prompt: Present Continuous Passive inkori: The empty boxes ___ (not move) at the moment.
20.9.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi ega bilan are not being + V3 ishlatiladi.

20.10.prompt: Ayni jarayon haqida to‘g‘ri passive savolni tanlang: A) Is the lift being inspected? B) Is being the lift inspected?
20.10.explanation: So‘roq tartibi is + ega + being + V3.

20.10.prompt: Present Continuous Passive: Why are the windows ___ (cover) right now?
20.10.explanation: Are oldinda bor; bo‘shliqqa being + V3 keladi.

20.11.prompt: Present Perfect Passive: The broken handle ___ (replace) already.
20.11.explanation: Birlikdagi ega uchun has been + V3 tugallangan ishning hozirgi natijasini bildiradi.

20.11.prompt: Present Perfect Passive: All the dishes ___ (wash). We can put them away now.
20.11.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi dishes bilan have been + V3 kerak.

20.12.prompt: Present Perfect Passive inkori: The new timetable ___ (not publish) yet.
20.12.explanation: Birlikdagi ega bilan has not been + V3 ishlatiladi.

20.12.prompt: Present Perfect Passive inkori: The spare keys ___ (not find) yet.
20.12.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi keys bilan have not been; find ning V3 shakli found.

20.13.prompt: Present Perfect Passive savolini tanlang: A) Have the tickets been printed? B) Have been the tickets printed?
20.13.explanation: Savol tartibi have + ega + been + V3.

20.13.prompt: Present Perfect Passive: Has the broken chair ___ (take) away?
20.13.explanation: Has oldinda bor; bo‘shliqqa been va take ning V3 shakli taken keladi.

21.1.prompt: Future Passive, will bilan: The meeting link ___ (send) tomorrow morning.
21.1.explanation: Kelajakdagi passive harakat will be + V3 bilan tuziladi.

21.1.prompt: Future Passive, will bilan: The old windows ___ (replace) next month.
21.1.explanation: Will barcha egalar bilan o‘zgarmaydi; undan keyin be + V3 keladi.

21.2.prompt: Future Passive inkori: The sports hall ___ (not close) during the holidays.
21.2.explanation: Future Passive inkori will not be + V3 bilan tuziladi.

21.2.prompt: Future Passive inkori: Your details ___ (not share) with other companies.
21.2.explanation: Ega details harakatni qabul qiladi; won't be shared kerak.

21.3.prompt: To‘g‘ri Future Passive savolni tanlang: A) When will the winners be announced? B) When will be the winners announced?
21.3.explanation: Wh-so‘zdan keyin will + ega + be + V3 tartibi keladi.

21.3.prompt: Future Passive savolini to‘ldiring: Will these chairs ___ (need) tomorrow?
21.3.explanation: Will oldinda berilgan; undan keyingi passive qism be + V3.

21.4.prompt: Can bilan passive shakl: This bag can ___ (reuse) many times.
21.4.explanation: Modal + be + V3: can be reused.

21.4.prompt: Should bilan passive shakl: The damaged cable should ___ (replace) immediately.
21.4.explanation: Should dan keyin passive ma’no uchun be + V3 ishlatiladi.

21.5.prompt: Taqiqni modal passive bilan tanlang: A) This exit mustn't be blocked. B) This exit doesn't have to be blocked.
21.5.explanation: Mustn't be + V3 taqiqni, doesn't have to esa zarurat yo‘qligini bildiradi.

21.5.prompt: Modal Passive inkori: These documents cannot ___ (remove) from the office.
21.5.explanation: Cannot dan keyin passive tuzilma be + V3 keladi.

21.6.prompt: To‘g‘ri modal passive savolni tanlang: A) Can be this fabric recycled? B) Can this fabric be recycled?
21.6.explanation: Savol tartibi modal + ega + be + V3.

21.6.prompt: Modal Passive savolini to‘ldiring: Should the receipt ___ (keep) for later?
21.6.explanation: Should dan keyin passive be + V3; keep ning V3 shakli kept.

21.7.prompt: Past Continuous Passive: The gate ___ (paint) when we arrived.
21.7.explanation: O‘tgan vaqtda davom etgan passive jarayon was being + V3 bilan tuziladi.

21.7.prompt: Past Continuous Passive: At ten yesterday, the carpets ___ (clean).
21.7.explanation: Ko‘plikdagi ega bilan were being + V3 kerak.

21.8.prompt: Past Continuous Passive inkori: The spare room ___ (not use) when I visited.
21.8.explanation: Birlikdagi ega bilan was not being + V3 ishlatiladi.

21.8.prompt: Past Continuous Passive inkori: The lifts ___ (not repair) at noon; the workers were at lunch.
21.8.explanation: Aynan o‘sha vaqtda jarayon davom etmagani were not being + V3 bilan aytiladi.

21.9.prompt: To‘g‘ri Past Continuous Passive savolni tanlang: A) Were the shelves being installed when you arrived? B) Did the shelves being installed when you arrived?
21.9.explanation: Past Continuous Passive savolida were egadan oldinga chiqadi.

21.9.prompt: Past Continuous Passive: Why was the entrance ___ (block) when the guests arrived?
21.9.explanation: Was oldinda berilgan; bo‘shliq being + V3 bilan to‘ldiriladi.

21.10.prompt: Past Perfect Passive: The tables ___ (set) before the guests arrived.
21.10.explanation: Boshqa o‘tgan voqeadan oldin tugallangan passive ish had been + V3 bilan aytiladi.

21.10.prompt: Past Perfect Passive: The lost wallet ___ (return) before I called the café.
21.10.explanation: Had been returned hamyon qo‘ng‘iroqdan oldin qaytarilganini bildiradi.

21.11.prompt: Past Perfect Passive inkori: The cake ___ (not cut) when the candles were brought in.
21.11.explanation: O‘tgan nuqtagacha tugallanmagan passive ish had not been + V3 shaklida keladi.

21.11.prompt: Past Perfect Passive inkori: Our seats ___ (not reserve) before the train became full.
21.11.explanation: Past Perfect Passive barcha egalar bilan had not been + V3 bo‘ladi.

21.12.prompt: To‘g‘ri Past Perfect Passive savolni tanlang: A) Had the files been copied before the computer failed? B) Had been the files copied before the computer failed?
21.12.explanation: Savol tartibi had + ega + been + V3.

21.12.prompt: Past Perfect Passive savoli: Had the bill ___ (pay) before the guests left?
21.12.explanation: Had oldinda bor; bo‘shliqda been + V3, ya’ni been paid kerak.

21.13.prompt: Bajaruvchini kiriting: The mural was painted ___ local volunteers. By yoki with ni tanlang.
21.13.explanation: Ishni bajargan shaxs yoki guruh passive gapda by bilan ko‘rsatiladi.

21.13.prompt: The bread was cut by Omar with a sharp knife. Ishni bajargan shaxsni aynan yozing.
21.13.explanation: By Omar bajaruvchini, with a sharp knife esa ishlatilgan asbobni bildiradi.
